grammar_focus: 形容词 + 介词固定搭配(教材 L70 考点,方案B换情节包):形容词+for(famous for/eager for/responsible for/ready for/sorry for)、形容词+of(proud of/afraid of/capable of/fond of/full of)、形容词+at(good at/quick at/surprised at)、形容词+to/with/about/on(grateful to/kind to/pleased with/worried about/keen on)
scene: 我们学校因社团众多而出名,人人都渴望在社团里有个名额。米娅画画很擅长,也喜欢画卡通。她哥哥为她感到自豪,可他自己却害怕当众讲话。“你应该负责美术社,”老师说,“你有能力领导它。”米娅对这个提议感到惊讶,也很感激老师。“我有点担心工作量,”她说,“不过我准备好迎接挑战了。”老师对她的回答很满意,对每个加入的人都很友善。很快,美术社就挤满了热爱艺术的学生。米娅为那些没能进来的人感到惋惜,但活动室只能容纳二十个人。到年底时,她因为办了全校最棒的一场画展而出了名。

grammar_card.title: 形容词 + 介词固定搭配
grammar_card.intro: 很多形容词后面跟固定的介词,要成组记:①+for——famous for(因…出名)、eager for(渴望)、responsible for(对…负责)、ready for(为…做好准备)、sorry for(为…惋惜);②+of——proud of(为…自豪)、afraid of(害怕)、capable of(有能力)、fond of(喜爱)、full of(充满);③+at——good at(擅长)、quick at(在…上反应快)、surprised at(对…惊讶);④+其他——grateful to(感激)、kind to(对…友善)、pleased with(对…满意)、worried about(担心)、keen on(热衷于)。

rows: Our school is famous for its clubs.
proud of / afraid of / capable of
He is afraid of speaking in public.
Mia was grateful to her teacher.
pleased with / worried about / keen on
The teacher was pleased with her answer.

specialRules.rule: 美语里“数学”说 math(英式 maths)、“橡皮”说 eraser(英式 rubber)、“成绩”说 grade(英式 mark);本课已按美语写。
形容词后的介词是固定的,靠成组记忆:good AT、afraid OF、famous FOR、grateful TO、pleased WITH、worried ABOUT、keen ON。不能随意替换。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What is the school famous for?

passage: Our school is famous for its many clubs, and everyone is eager for a place in one. Mia is really good at painting and fond of drawing cartoons. Her brother is proud of her, but he's afraid of speaking in public himself. "You should be responsible for the art club," the teacher said. "You're capable of leading it." Mia was surprised at the offer and grateful to her teacher. "I'm a little worried about the work," she said, "but I'm ready for a challenge." The teacher was pleased with her answer and kind to everyone who joined. Soon the club was full of students keen on art. Mia was sorry for the ones who couldn't get in, but the room was capable of holding only twenty. By the end of the year, she was famous for the best art show the school had ever seen.
